value.rationale: The exact maximum relaxation time for every ring size and density, complete enumeration of maximally slow indexed states, Catalan structure, and a nontrivial fixed-excess critical limit answer a motivated global-jam-clearance probability question. Unlike isolated examples or coarse bounds, they quantify the incidence of extremal delay for a natural canonical traffic automaton.
